topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the session by connecting histopathology practicals to cellular changes and outlining the lecture's learning objectives.

topics.label: Viral discovery of oncogenes and transformation assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the investigation of transforming tumor viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to evaluate cellular transformation.

topics.label: Properties and mechanisms of oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail how cancer-associated mutations are classified by their functional effects and how their mutational mechanisms alter cell cycle regulation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and dynamics of genetic instability in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the cellular defects that generate sequence and chromosomal instability and how this genomic instability accelerates the stepwise progression of tumors.

topics.label: Hereditary cancer predisposition syndromes
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how inheriting germline mutations accelerates cancer development and how inherited DNA repair deficiencies behave during tumor progression and therapy.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer concludes the presentation by reviewing learning outcomes, inviting questions, and recommending further reading for the vacation period.
